preconditions.description: Attacker must have minter role (either be owner or be set as minter via setMinter function)
Attacker address must not be blacklisted

exploit_hint: As a minter (either owner or designated minter), call the mint() function with your address as the recipient and an arbitrary large amount. This will inflate the token supply and increase your balance without any upper limit. You can then transfer these tokens to other addresses or exchange them for other assets.
